zh-CN.title: 边界状态体验升级
items: 无权访问的会话改为轻量提示并自动返回会话列表
账号查找、发言与评论加载采用更安静的动态骨架
广场、通讯和通知等空列表统一为轻量留白状态

en.title: Refined boundary states
items: Unavailable conversations now show a lightweight notice and return to the chat list
Account, statement, and comment loading now use subtle animated skeletons
Empty Square, Contacts, and notification lists now share a quieter layout
